title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A test that watched the clock
summary: No change to the extension. One of our own tests measured elapsed time and failed on a loaded build machine, so it now asserts on behaviour instead.

highlights.title: No clock in the test suite
highlights.description: A regression test guarded a shortcut with a threshold in milliseconds. It checks the two outcomes that matter instead: a file with no state produces no lens, and a file with a single state keeps its lens and its indirect writes.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Nothing shipped in the extension itself. Version 1.42.42 was published correctly; only the test job was red.
